main_body: large half-timbered house with tiled hip/gable roof
top_band: red-brown and ochre tiled roof slopes from row 0 to row 42 on the main wings (and down to row 56/74 on the front gable)
evidence: The main roof spans rows 0-42 (43 rows) on the left/right wings and rows 0-56 in the center before meeting the front gable wall (rows 55-107). A dark eave line and 2-3 rows of grey shadow sit directly under the roof overhang (rows 43-46 and 75-78), and the doors and windows are inset.

style.evidence: The candidate uses the exact same Beodeul roof tile scallops, timber beams, speckled plaster walls, and chimney tiles as the reference houses on the left.
